## v0.5.55 · Smaller UI bundles and configurable idle reviews / 更轻的前端与可配置的闲时复盘

### English

- The Starter and four official Sources load smaller browser bundles. The Starter's client JavaScript is about 26% smaller, and the Memory Spaces page still includes both graph views. ([#739](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/739))
- Set the continuous idle wait to between 5 seconds and 24 hours under **Review limits** on the Layered strategy settings page. The default is 30 seconds. ([#740](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/740))
- **Freeze at session start** preserves the prompt prefix across routine changes to Project Documents and Memory Spaces. Explicit reads use the current catalog, and disabling a space refreshes affected snapshots. ([#741](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/741))
- When a memory subagent stops without a result, the error can now include the last observed tool failure with credentials redacted. ([#735](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/735))

### 简体中文

- Starter 和四个官方 Source 的前端包体积更小。Starter 的客户端 JavaScript 缩小约 26%，记忆空间页面保留两种图谱视图。([#739](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/739))
- 在分层策略的**审查参数**中，可把复盘前的连续空闲等待设为 5 秒至 24 小时。默认 30 秒。([#740](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/740))
- 选择**会话开始时冻结**后，项目档案和记忆空间的日常更新会保留提示词前缀。显式读取使用最新目录，停用空间时会刷新受影响的快照。([#741](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/741))
- 记忆子 Agent 未提交结果时，如果有工具失败，报错会附上最近一次脱敏后的工具错误。([#735](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/735))

Update from **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 在**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**中升级，然后完整重启 DSH。
